children: Foreign currency sales by Russian companies fell 15% month-on-month to $18.8 billion in August due to delays in the receipt of export proceeds, the central bank said in a report on Monday.
Net purchases of foreign currency by individuals fell to 74.0 billion roubles ($875.8 million) from 97.2 billion roubles in July, the central bank said.
